issues.where: WED, OCT 28 · Ouray County Board of County Commissioners Work Session
issues.quote: The Ouray County Board of County Commissioners Work Session also meets Wednesday
issues.problem: The intro paragraph says this work session meets Wednesday, which matches the body, but the intro also placed it on Tuesday — creating a direct contradiction within the intro itself (flagged separately above). Additionally, the Wednesday BOCC Work Session and the Tuesday BOCC Work Session are two distinct meetings both tagged 'Ouray County · Ouray County Board of County Commissioners Work Session', making it easy to confuse them; the Wednesday one could be more clearly distinguished.
issues.suggestion: This is a structural/labeling issue; consider distinguishing the two Ouray County BOCC Work Sessions (e.g. noting different topics) so readers are not misled into thinking it is a duplicate listing.
issues.resolution: fixed: new intro (John's edits restored, intro rewritten 10/25)

issues.where: TUE, OCT 27 · Town of Telluride · Town Council
issues.problem: The intro paragraph says 'Tuesday, the Telluride Town Council holds a regular meeting' but does not mention the time; the body lists 10:00 AM. Cross-checking the day: Tuesday October 27 is correct. However, the Ouray County BOCC is also listed at 9:00 AM on Tuesday and its work session at 1:30 PM — the Town Council at 10:00 AM overlaps with the BOCC; this is not itself an error. The real issue: the intro lists the Telluride Town Council before mentioning the Ouray County items, consistent with the body, so no error there. No issue confirmed here — disregard.
issues.resolution: not an error (the review said no action needed)
